name: key-icon
title: Key Icon
description: An icon container with various styles, sizes, and colors.

migration.guide: KeyIcon now uses namespace exports (KeyIcon.Root instead of default export). Replace `import KeyIcon from` with `import * as KeyIcon from`. The `icon` prop still works, but you can also pass children. Switched from cva to tv. Removed class-variance-authority dependency.

docs.lead: An icon container with configurable styles, sizes, and semantic colors.

examples.title: Stroke Style
examples.description: Default stroke style with neutral border and shadow.

examples.title: Lighter Style
examples.description: Lighter style with semantic background and border colors.

examples.title: Filled Style
examples.description: Solid background with white icon for high emphasis.

examples.title: Colors
examples.description: All available semantic colors in both styles.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon to display. Alternatively, pass as children.

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic color. Affects the lighter and filled styles.
